statement: Native Computational Review TRUST v2 data, preserved verbatim. These are not ORAtlas TrustAssessmentRecords: no ORAtlas criterion, aggregate, reviewer identity, attestation or verified status is expressed or implied, and no score was converted.

evidence_levels.producer_finding: A finding about a cited article in a Diggypaper evidence packet. Bound by packet and finding source hashes. Not a review claim.
evidence_levels.review_claim: A sentence authored in this review (claims.jsonl). Identity is the native claim_id, unchanged.
evidence_levels.graph_relation: A claim-graph edge between a review claim and a citation (relations.jsonl). Derived by the TRUST validator; human confirmation is recorded only via human_review_required and release decision references, never inferred here.
